answer_1.quote: G2T verbalizes the structural information in KG with descriptive texts... we propose INFINITY, a simple unsupervised approach to graph-text mutual conversion.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language texts from graphs and generated linearized triple sequences (graphs) from texts

answer_2.quote: For G2T, we adopt several widely used automatic metrics, i.e., BLEU, Meteor, and CIDEr. For T2G, we use the micro F1 score to evaluate the quality of the generated triples.
